description: Election Commission - Elected as a member Mr. A. W. M. Shihan of the Kotidawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to non-attendance of meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member for a specific electoral ward, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters.
